IRS990.MissionDesc: ITEP IS A NON-PROFIT, NON-PARTISAN TAX POLICY ORGANIZATION. WE CONDUCT RIGOROUS ANALYSES OF TAX AND ECONOMIC PROPOSALS AND PROVIDE DATA-DRIVEN RECOMMENDATIONS ON HOW TO SHAPE EQUITABLE AND SUSTAINABLE TAX SYSTEMS. ITEP'S EXPERTISE AND DATA UNIQUELY ENHANCE FEDERAL, STATE, AND LOCAL POLICY DEBATES BY REVEALING HOW TAXES AFFECT BOTH PUBLIC REVENUES AND PEOPLE OF VARIOUS LEVELS OF INCOME AND WEALTH.
IRS990.Desc: ITEP CONDUCTS RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS OF FEDERAL, STATE AND LOCAL TAX PROPOSALS. ITEP USES A MICROSIMULATION MODEL THAT CONTAINS THE BEST AND MOST UP-TO-DATE INFORMATION ON TAX INCIDENCE BY INCOME, RACE, ETHNICITY AND PLACE. ITEP WORKS CLOSELY WITH PARTNERS NATIONWIDE TO UNDERSTAND THE DISTRIBUTIONAL IMPLICATIONS OF TAX PROPOSALS AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS ABOUT HOW TO RAISE MORE REVENUE AND BRING ABOUT MORE DISTRIBUTIONAL EQUITY THROUGH THE TAX CODE. IN 2025, ITEP RELEASED 150 REPORT, TRACKED NEARLY 8,000 MEDIA MENTIONS, SAW 3 MILLION VIEWS TO OUR WEBSITE, AND ASSISTED PARTNERS IN NEARLY EVERY STATE WITH MODELING ON IMPLICATIONS OF TAX PROPOSALS OR WITH RESEARCH ON STATE TAX POLICY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. A COPY OF THE FINAL FORM 990 WAS PROVIDED TO ALL BOARD MEMBERS PRIOR TO FILING WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS DISTRIBUTED ANNUALLY TO ALL DIRECTORS, OFFICERS, AND MEMBERS OF BOARD COMMITTEES. ALL COVERED INDIVIDUALS SIGN AN ANNUAL ACKNOWLEDGMENT THAT THEY HAVE RECEIVED A COPY OF THIS POLICY, UNDERSTAND IT, AND AGREE TO ABIDE BY ITS TERMS. WHEN EVER A DIRECTOR, OFFICER, OR COMMITTEE MEMBER BECOMES AWARE OF A POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST, WHETHER FINANCIAL OR OTHERWISE, S/HE MAKES THE SITUATION KNOWN TO THE BOARD OR COMMITTEE (AS THE CASE MAY BE) AND PROVIDES ALL FACTS MATERIAL TO UNDERSTANDING THE NATURE AND SCOPE OF THE CONFLICT, INCLUDING WHETHER THE INTERESTED PERSON BELIEVES HIS OR HER ABILITY TO MAKE AN INDEPENDENT DECISION BASED SOLELY ON THE BEST INTEREST OF THE CORPORATION HAS BEEN COMPROMISED. IF THE INTERESTED PERSON INVOLVED DOES NOT MAKE THIS DISCLOSURE, ANOTHER DIRECTOR OR COMMITTEE MEMBER WITH KNOWLEDGE OF THE POTENTIAL CONFLICT DRAWS IT TO THE BODY'S ATTENTION. THE INTERESTED PERSON WITH THE POTENTIAL CONFLICT LEAVES THE MEETING AND DOES NOT PARTICIPATE IN FINAL DISCUSSION AND VOTING ON THE EXISTENCE OF THE CONFLICT. IF A CONFLICT IS FOUND TO EXIST, THE INTERESTED PERSON IS INVITED TO PROVIDE ANY RELEVANT INFORMATION THAT COULD BE OF USE TO THE BOARD IN MAKING ITS DECISION, BUT DOES NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE FINAL DISCUSSION AND VOTING REGARDING THE TRANSACTION. THE BOARD OR COMMITTEE'S DECISION IS BASED ON CONSIDERATION OF WHETHER THE TRANSACTION IS IN THE ORGANIZATION'S BEST INTEREST AND FOR ITS OWN BENEFIT, IS FAIR AND REASONABLE TO THE ORGANIZATION, AND IS THE MOST ADVANTAGEOUS TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT THE ORGANIZATION CAN OBTAIN WITH REASONABLE EFFORTS UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES.
